title.zh: 调护观与预后观：先养后治，“治愈”与“生命”分开说
title.en: His View of Care and Prognosis: Living Right Before and Beside Treatment, and "Cure" and "Life" Told Apart

summary.zh: 《针灸处方集》每条分【处方】【调护】【预后】三段。219条中136条有调护，166条有预后。调护以饮食(忌烟酒冷食、清淡、营养)、安静休养、保温、情志与去原因为主，肺结核、癫痫等条把“摄生”排在治法之前；预后的措辞分良好、有条件、缓慢难愈、不一定、不良五类，并把“生命有无危险”与“能否治愈”分开说。
summary.en: Each entry has three parts: prescription, care and prognosis. Of 219 entries 136 carry care advice and 166 a prognosis. Care is mainly diet (no tobacco, alcohol or cold food, bland, nourishing), rest, warmth, mind and removing the cause; the TB and epilepsy entries put hygiene ahead of treatment. Prognosis wording falls in five kinds (good, conditional, slow or hard, variable, poor), and he tells "danger to life" apart from "curability".

takeaways.zh: 调护并不是每条都有，而是集中在需要日常调摄的病：消化器病45条中43条有调护，呼吸器21条中18条，循环器11条中10条，泌尿生殖器17条中16条；脑脊髓神经系74条中只有26条(35%)，多数神经麻痹、神经痛条没有调护段；传染病16条与内分泌4条没有调护段，传染病改写“消毒”(11条)。全书136/219(62%)。
takeaways.en: Care is not in every entry but concentrated in diseases needing daily regulation: 43 of 45 digestive entries, 18 of 21 respiratory, 10 of 11 circulatory, 16 of 17 urogenital; only 26 of 74 nervous-system entries (35%), most paralysis and neuralgia entries having no care part; the 16 infectious and 4 endocrine entries have none, the infectious ones carrying disinfection instead (11 entries). Overall 136 of 219 (62%).

takeaways.zh: 饮食是最常见的调护内容，并且“忌”与“补”两头都讲：忌烟酒、冷食、刺激性食物31条，清淡、蔬食、少肉20条，营养、滋养24条。例如慢性支气管炎“摒除冷饮，减少烟酒与刺激物”，心脏瓣膜症“淡食与富有营养品之食物”，癫痫“尤忌牛羊鸡肉，常能蔬食更佳”，十二指肠溃疡“少食多餐，禁止冷食与烟酒”。
takeaways.en: Diet is the commonest care content, and he speaks of both "avoid" and "supplement": no tobacco, alcohol, cold or irritant food in 31 entries, bland vegetable diet with little meat in 20, nutrition and nourishment in 24. Chronic bronchitis: "ban cold drinks, cut tobacco, alcohol and irritants"; valvular heart disease: "bland food and nutritious food"; epilepsy: "especially avoid beef, mutton and chicken, vegetarian is better"; duodenal ulcer: "small frequent meals, no cold food, tobacco or alcohol".

takeaways.zh: 安静与运动、保温与情志按病性分开：急性、炎症与出血多要“绝对安静”“静卧”(安静休养32条)，慢性、虚弱与功能性病则要“户外运动”“日光”(20条：脂肪心、贫血、胃扩张、神经衰弱症、佝偻病)；胸背、腹腰与关节要保温(18条)，膝关节炎尤其“绝对不用冷罨法”；避免过劳12条；情志(清心寡欲、怡悦、戒恼怒)18条，多见于心脏、消化与神经病。
takeaways.en: Rest and exercise, warmth and mood are assigned by the nature of the disease: acute, inflammatory and bleeding conditions need "absolute rest" or lying quiet (32 entries), while chronic, weak and functional ones want "outdoor exercise" and sunshine (20 entries: fatty heart, anaemia, gastric dilatation, neurasthenia, rickets); chest, back, abdomen, waist and joints are kept warm (18 entries), knee arthritis with "no cold compress at all"; avoiding overwork 12; mood (clear the heart, cheerfulness, no anger) 18, mostly in heart, digestive and nerve disease.

takeaways.zh: 他在几条里明说“第一”“最要”，排出调护的优先次序，共8条，并且排在第一的多是情志、去原因或摄生，而不是饮食：肺结核“解除忧虑烦恼为第一”，且“摄生重于治疗”，“不死于治法之不善，实死于摄养之未能尽善”；食管狭窄“首先摒除忧郁”，食管痉挛“情志愉快为首要”，神经性消化不良“情志愉快为第一”，癫痫“清心寡欲，为第一调护法”；萎黄病“去其原因为第一”，歇斯底里“除去原因为最要”；脊髓痨“注意摄生为第一”。
takeaways.en: In eight entries he says "first" or "most important" and sets a priority order, and what comes first is mood, removing the cause or hygiene rather than diet. Pulmonary TB: "relieving worry is first", "hygiene weighs more than treatment", "people do not die of poor treatment but of poor nurture"; oesophageal stricture "first dispel gloom", oesophageal spasm "cheerful mood is the chief thing", nervous dyspepsia "cheerful mood comes first", epilepsy "clear heart and few desires is the first care"; chlorosis "removing the cause comes first", hysteria "removing the cause is most important"; tabes "hygiene comes first".

takeaways.zh: 预后写了166条(76%)，措辞可归五类(编者按用语分组)：良好类62条(37%)，有条件45条，缓慢难愈21条，不一定23条，不良／危险14条，另1条为“数分钟至数十分钟即醒”。他很少给绝对的话：良好类多写“多良”“大多良好”，“不良”“多不良”这样的直白结论只见于喉头癌、食管狭窄、脊髓炎、脑动脉硬化症等。
takeaways.en: A prognosis is written for 166 entries (76%), and the wording falls into five kinds (editor's grouping by phrase): favourable 62 (37%), conditional 45, slow or hard to cure 21, variable 23, poor or dangerous 14, plus one "wakes within minutes". He rarely gives absolutes: the favourable kind is mostly "mostly good" or "generally good", and the bare "poor" or "mostly poor" appears only for laryngeal cancer, oesophageal stricture, myelitis, cerebral arteriosclerosis and the like.

takeaways.zh: 哪类病得哪类预后，大体有规律(见表1)：急性炎症、神经痛、妇科炎症与五官病多写“多良”(如急性喉头炎“大多良好”，肌肉偻麻质斯“针灸收效较速，预后多良”)；慢性、功能性与器质性病写“不易全治”“治愈则难”；有并发症、晚期或脊髓、脑血管病写“不良”(如急性脊髓膜炎“麻痹症状发现后，即转归不良”，麻痹狂“年深久者不良”)；急性传染病与重症写死亡或不治(小叶性肺炎“多数不治”，疫痢“一二日内死亡”，糖尿病重者“昏睡而亡”)。
takeaways.en: Kinds of disease and kinds of prognosis follow a rough pattern (Table 1): acute inflammation, neuralgia, gynaecological inflammation and ENT disease mostly get "generally good" (acute laryngitis "mostly good", muscular rheumatism "needling works faster, prognosis mostly good"); chronic, functional and organic disease get "not fully curable" or "cure is difficult"; complications, late stage or spinal and cerebrovascular disease get "poor" (acute meningitis "poor once paralysis appears", mania "poor if long-standing"); acute infection and severe cases get death or "untreatable" (bronchopneumonia "mostly untreatable", epidemic dysentery "death within one or two days", severe diabetes "dies in coma").

takeaways.zh: 他把“生命”与“治愈”分成两条轴。明说生命无危险的10条里，9条紧接着说治愈难、顽固或收效慢：慢性支气管炎“生命上无危险，久治乃有显效”，肺气肿“完全根治则难”，神经性消化不良“但为顽固之病症”，肠弛缓症“治愈则难”，颜面神经痉挛“甚有终身不愈者”，歇斯底里“治愈则不易，必须经年治疗”，偏头痛“不易收捷效”。反过来，说“危险”的14条多是急性重症或有并发症的病(心脏痉挛、动脉硬化症、胃溃疡并发症、急性肾脏炎并发尿毒症)。
takeaways.en: He treats "life" and "cure" as two axes. Of the 10 entries that say life is not endangered, 9 go on to say cure is difficult, the disease stubborn or the response slow: chronic bronchitis "no danger to life, but effect only after long treatment", emphysema "complete cure is hard", nervous dyspepsia "but a stubborn disease", atonic bowel "cure is hard", facial spasm "some never recover", hysteria "cure is not easy, a year or more of treatment", migraine "no quick effect". Conversely the 14 that speak of danger are mostly acute severe disease or complications (angina, arteriosclerosis, gastric ulcer with complications, acute nephritis with uraemia).

takeaways.zh: 同一病的预后，他常写明“什么条件下”会变：并发症或合并症(11条)，早治或初期(15条)，病因(10条：“视原因”“去其原因”“原因不去，每多反复”)，病久、年久(7条)，以及调养摄养(8条：脑溢血“视摄养如何而不一定”，癫痫“针治与调养配合得宜”，神经衰弱症“视治疗与休养配合得宜与否”)。另有4条写“可以延年”或“生命可延”(心脏瓣膜症、脂肪心、肝脏硬化症、振颤麻痹)，都以“调养得法”为前提。
takeaways.en: He often names the condition on which a prognosis turns: complications (11 entries), early treatment or early stage (15), the cause (10: "depends on the cause", "remove the cause", "if the cause is not removed it often recurs"), long standing (7), and regulated living (8: cerebral haemorrhage "depends on how one nurtures oneself", epilepsy "needling and nurture in step", neurasthenia "depends on treatment and rest working together"). Four more say "may prolong life" (valvular heart disease, fatty heart, cirrhosis, Parkinsonism), all on the premise of good regulation.

body.zh: 调护段里的建议大致有四层：(1)日常生活(饮食、安静、保温、运动日光、情志、避免过劳)；(2)去病因或原发病(20条，如“有梅毒、结核、心脏病者，必须同时助以适当之治疗”“去其原因为第一”)；(3)局部护理与简单家用法(含漱、硼酸水、按摩、压腹带、胃托，共约20条)；(4)专医、药物与外科的配合(39条含相关字样，见 cda-32)。第(1)层与第(2)层出现最多，说明他把针灸放在生活调摄与病因治疗的旁边，而不是替代它们。
body.en: Care advice falls into four layers: (1) daily life (diet, quiet, warmth, exercise and sunshine, mood, avoiding overwork); (2) removing the cause or the primary disease (20 entries, e.g. "where there is syphilis, TB or heart disease, treatment must go alongside", "removing the cause comes first"); (3) local care and simple home measures (gargle, boric-acid water, massage, abdominal belt, stomach support, some 20 entries); (4) working with a specialist, drugs or surgery (39 entries with relevant wording, see cda-32). Layers 1 and 2 are commonest, which shows he places acupuncture beside life regulation and cause treatment, not in place of them.

h.zh: 肺结核：调护第一的样本

body.zh: 肺结核一条没有单列的【预后】，却写了全书最长的调护。他先说“首先应改善生活条件，变换环境，解除精神上之负担，尤以后者为最重要”，认为一般的治疗“注重于休养与营养，其次为药物”，针灸是在这两项之外再加。调护段结论是“肺病以摄生重于治疗”，并以自己20余年的临床所得作证：肺病之死“不死于治法之不善，实死于摄养之未能尽善”。这是书中对“调护先于治疗”说得最明的一处，不应推到其他病；但癫痫、脊髓痨等条同样把摄生或清心寡欲排在第一。
body.en: The TB entry has no separate prognosis line but the longest care text in the book. He begins "first improve living conditions, change environment, lift the mental burden, the last most important of all", and says ordinary treatment "stresses rest and nutrition, drugs second", acupuncture being added to those two. The care section concludes "hygiene weighs more than treatment" and testifies from twenty-odd years of practice that TB patients "die not of poor treatment but of poor nurture". This is the plainest statement of care before treatment in the book and should not be spread to every disease, though epilepsy, tabes and others likewise put hygiene or a clear heart first.

body.zh: 第一，预后是他对“转归”的估计，不是疗效数字：全书没有给出治愈率，最具体的时程只在个别条目(脚气“治疗一二周收效”与“非一二个月不可”，见 cda-11)。第二，有几处预后直接引用别人的判断或标出自己的经验界线，如鼠疫“据新医书指示，侵入肺脏者多不良，败血性者，一发即死”；坐骨神经痛“如经过电疗久治者，再用针灸，收效则缓，此在个人历年临床所得之经验，还待多数针灸医家之证实”。读这些句子时要区分“书中转述”“他的经验”与“他的推想”。
body.en: First, the prognosis is his estimate of the outcome, not a cure rate: the book gives no success figures, and the most specific timescales are in single entries (beriberi "one or two weeks" against "not under one or two months", see cda-11). Second, several prognoses quote others or mark the limit of his own experience, e.g. plague "according to modern medical books, invasion of the lungs is mostly poor, the septic form kills at once"; sciatica "if long electrotherapy came first, needling responds slowly, this being my own experience over the years, still to be confirmed by many acupuncturists". When reading these keep apart what the book relays, what he experienced and what he supposes.

how_to_use.zh: 读一条处方，先读【调护】：它常比取穴更像他对这类病的整体想法(生活、原因、专医)。再读【预后】，分清三件事：会不会危险，能不能治愈，依什么条件变化。遇到“视原因”“早治”“调养得法”这类条件句，把它当作他对疗效与生活调摄的联系。表1、表2的条数与分类是编者的整理，用来查找，不代表书中的正式分类。
how_to_use.en: Read the care section of an entry first: it often shows his overall idea of the disease (life, cause, specialist) better than the point list. Then read the prognosis and separate three things: is there danger, can it be cured, and on what conditions does it change. Treat conditional lines such as "depends on the cause", "early treatment", "well regulated" as his link between results and daily living. The counts and kinds in Tables 1 and 2 are the editor's tabulation for lookup, not the book's own classification.

caveats.zh: 预后用语出自1951年前后的临床判断，所涉疾病名多为民国西医病名(如脚气、肺结核、胃下垂)，预后并不代表今日疗效；条数为对原书中文的重新统计，预后分类是编者按措辞归组。
caveats.en: The prognoses are clinical judgements of about 1951 about diseases named in Republican-era Western terms (beriberi, TB, gastroptosis) and do not reflect today's outcomes; counts are a recount of the Chinese text and the kinds are the editor's grouping by wording.
